main_text.head: CAP. X. De testimonio Gregorij Magni, & interi-tu Phocæ Mauritij interfectoris.
main_text.p: Iustiniano successit Iustinus Iunior; Iu-stino Tiberius; Tiberio autem Mauri-tius. Illo Imperante, Romanæ Ecclesiæ præsidebat Gregorius eius nominis Pri-mus, & cognomento Magnus:q; licet alicubi renitatur Legi Imperatoris, ut ipse putabat iniustę:quâ ꝓphibuit[?], ne milites in Monasteria suscipiantur; ibidem tũ fatetur, {e}Lib.II. Indict. II. Epist.62.Deo reum esse qui serenissimis Dominis in omne quod agit & loquitur, purus nō est. Alibi et conqueritur, se Imperatore fatuitatis insimulasse, q; licet ostendat fuisse indignū & Imperiali maiestate quæ faceret, & gravitate sacerdotali quæ pateretur; tandem tũ cum precibus & lachrymis in hunc modum concludit: [{f}Epist.31. lib.4. Indict.13.Inter hæc ergo omnia in-certa, ad solas lachrymas redeo, petens, ut idē omnipotens Deus pijssimū Dominum nostrum, et sua hic manu regat, & in illo terribili judicio liber ab omnibus delictis inveniat.] Nihil hic animo-sus Pontifex de Anathemate, de depo-fitione

page.notes: The right printed page is cut off at the scan edge; only its edge fragments are visible, so nothing from it is transcribed. The running head shows "LIB.III" beside "Scutum Regium." on this page; only the title is given as running head. "quâ ꝓphibuit" is uncertain (the ꝓ abbreviation could be read differently). The square bracket before "Inter" and the one after "inveniat." are printed. No catchword or signature is visible. Printed spelling kept: "pijssimū", "idē", "nō", "tũ".
